{{Quote|I'm incident commander. I say how and when anyone goes in.|Dovel to Omega Squad|<ref name="OS:T" />}}
The rank of '''incident commander''' was utilized by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was given as a temporary designation to the [[Police officer/Legends|officer]] placed in charge of a major [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] operation, regardless of the officer's [[Police rank|rank]]. The incident commander had control of all police resources at the scene of the incident and was in charge of planning all negotiations.<ref name="OS:T" />

The [[Commander/Legends|commander]] also had final say on tactical options. During the [[Galactic City Spaceport]] [[Galactic City spaceport hostage siege|hostage crisis]]<ref name="OS:T" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Omega Squad: Targets]]'', which include Dovel's tenure as Incident Commander, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> in which [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] took control of the Galactic City Spaceport on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Coruscant Security Force [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Dovel]] was the designated incident commander.<ref name="OS:T" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rank of incident commander appeared in "[[Omega Squad: Targets]]," a short story written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 81|''Star Wars Insider'' 81]]<ref name="OS:T" /> on [[March 11]], [[2005]].<ref name="SW">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050301.html|text=General Kenobi in ''Star Wars Insider'' #81}}</ref>
